content: Yahuda idweř d azeǧif awarni i řmewt n Yacuwa
Awarni i řmewt n Yacuwa, imsar aqa ayt n Israil sseqsan SIDI, nnan: “Man wen zzayneɣ i ɣa ikkaren d amezwaru ad igeɛɛed ad immneɣ ak-d ayt n Kenɛan?”
Yarra-dd SIDI: “Yahuda ad igeɛɛed d amezwaru. Xzar, Necc wciɣ as tammurt deg ufus nnes.”

Uca inna Yahuda i umas Cimɛun: “Geɛɛed akidi di temmurt n tqedduḥt n řeɛbar inu uca ejj aneɣ ad nemmneɣ ak-d ayt n Kenɛan, xenni necc ad kik geɛɛdeɣ di temmurt n tqedduḥt nnec.” Uca yuyur akides Cimɛun.
Igeɛɛed Yahuda uca SIDI iɛarn ayt n Kenɛan d Ifiriziyyen deg ufus nsen uca ɣeřben xasen ɣar Bazaq, ɛecra-ařaf n yiryazen.
Nitni ufin Aduni-Bazaq di Bazaq uca mmenɣen akides u nitni ɣeřben x ayt n Kenɛan u x Ifiriziyyen.
Maca Aduni-Bazaq yarweř uca nitni ḍfaren t uca ṭṭfen t uca qessen as imzawen d tfednin timeqqranin zeg ifassen nnes u zeg iḍaren nnes.

Xenni inna Aduni-Bazaq: “Sebɛin n ijeǧiden, ttwaqessen asen imzawen d tfednin, tuɣa řeqqḍen iřeqqʷaz sadu ṭṭabřa inu. Mammec i kidsen ggiɣ, ammu i d ayi ixeǧeṣ AREBBI!” Iwyen t ɣar Urcalim uca netta immut dinni.
Ayt n Yahuda mmenɣen ak-d Urcalim uca ṭṭfen tt, wtin tt s řeqḍeɛ n ssif uca qqeden tandint s tmessi.
Awarni as hwan ayt n Yahuda ḥima ad mmenɣen ak-d ayt n Kenɛan, inni izeddɣen di Temmurt n Idurar, di Temmurt n Ljanub u di Temmurt Iwaṭan.
Iffeɣ Yahuda ɣar ayt n Kenɛan i tuɣa izeddɣen di Ḥabrun. Isem n Ḥabrun tuɣa zic qqaren as Qaryat-Arbaɛ. Nitni ɣeřben x Cicay d Aximan d Talmay.
Ssenni iffeɣ ɣar imezdaɣ n Dabir. Isem n Dabir tuɣa zic qqaren as Qaryat-Safar.
Inna Kalib: “Wenni i ɣa iwten Qaryat-Safar ad tt iṭṭef, ad as wceɣ yeǧi Axsa d tamɣart.”
Ɛutniyil, mmis n Qinaz, umas ameẓyan n Kalib, iṭṭef i-tt. Uca Kalib iwca as yeǧis Axsa d tamɣart.
Imsar umi ɣares dd-tusa nettat, tɛarn i-t s tutra x yeyyar n babas. Uca teḍra x weɣyuř. Isseqsa tt Kalib: “Min cem yuɣin?”
Nettat tarra-dd xas: “Ewc ayi ict n lbaraka, minzi tewcid ayi ict n treqqiɛt n temmurt ɣar ljanub. Ttzawgeɣ, ewc ayi uřa d řɛunṣarat!” Uca iwca as Kalib řɛunṣarat n nej d řɛunṣarat n wadday.
Geɛɛden arraw n Uqini, wenni d aḍegʷař n Musa, ak-d ayt n Yahuda zi Tendint n Tcejjura n Tini ɣar řexřa n Yahuda nni iǧan di Temmurt n Ljanub ɣar Ɛarad. Ffɣen nitni, zeddɣen ak-d řgens.
Iruḥ Yahuda ak-d umas Cimɛun uca ɣeřben nitni x ayt n Kenɛan inni i tuɣa izeddɣen di Ṣafat, ḥarrmen ten qaɛ uca teḥḥan ten uca ggin as i tendint nni Ḥurma.
Iṭṭef Yahuda uřa d Ɣazza ak-d temmurt nnes d Acqalun ak-d temmurt nnes d Ɛaqrun ak-d temmurt nnes.
SIDI tuɣa-t ak-d Yahuda ařami yuẓẓeř x imezdaɣ n Temmurt n Idurar, maca imezdaɣ n řewda n teɣzurt war izemmar ad xasen yaẓẓeř zi tesɣart nsen, minzi nitni tuɣa ɣarsen ikarruten n umenɣi n wuzzař.
I Kalib wcin as Ḥabrun, am mammec tuɣa inna Musa, uca netta yuẓẓeř ssenni x třata n iḥenjiren n Ɛanaq.
Ayt n Binyamin war zemmaren ad aẓẓřen x Iyabusiyyen, inni izeddɣen di Urcalim. Ammu i qqimen Iyabusiyyen zeddɣen ɣar ayt n Binyamin di Urcalim, ař ass-a.
Taddart n Yusuf tgeɛɛed ɣar Bayt-Il uca SIDI tuɣa-t akidsen.
Tuyur taddart n Yusuf ḥima ad tbergag ɣar Bayt-Il. Isem n tendint tuɣa zic qqaren as Luz.
Inni tuɣa iřebten i tendint, ẓrin ijj n weryaz iffeɣ-dd zi tendint, nnan as: “Scen aneɣ manis nzemmar ad nadef ɣar tendint, xenni neccin ad kik negg tamexsiwt icewwaren.”
Xenni isscen asen tawwart n wadaf ɣar tendint uca nitni wtin tandint s ict n tecti s řeqḍeɛ n ssif, maca nitni jjin aryaz nni ad yuyur ak-d marra raǧ nnes.
Uca yuyur weryaz ɣar temmurt n Iḥittiyyen uca ibna ict n tendint, igga as isem Luz. Wa d isem nnes ař ass-a.

Manassa war izemmar ad yaẓẓeř x imezdaɣ n Bayt-Can d tneddam i ɣares dd-iqqnen, řa x imezdaɣ n Taɛnak ak-d tneddam nnes řa x imezdaɣ n Dur d tneddam nnes řa x imezdaɣ n Yiblaɛam d tneddam nnes uřa x imezdaɣ n Majiddu d tneddam nnes. Tuɣa ayt n Kenɛan ɛewwřen ad qqimen zeddɣen di temmurt nni.
Tuɣa Israil idweř ijhed ařami igga ljizya x ayt n Kenɛan, maca war zemmaren ad xasen aẓẓřen marra.
Uřa d Ifrayim war izemmar ad yaẓẓeř x ayt n Kenɛan i tuɣa izeddɣen di Jazar u qqimen ayt n Kenɛan zeddɣen di řwesṭ nsen di Jazar.
Zabulun war izemmar ad yaẓẓeř x imezdaɣ n Qiṭrun d imezdaɣ n Nahalul u qqimen ayt n Kenɛan zeddɣen di řwesṭ nsen u tᵉttwagg xasen ljizya.
Acir war izemmar ad yaẓẓeř x imezdaɣ n Ɛakku uřa x imezdaɣ n Ṣidun d Aḥlab d Akzib d Halba d Afiq d Raḥub.
Iciriyyen zeddɣen di řwesṭ n ayt n Kenɛan, inni d imezdaɣ n temmurt, minzi nitni war zemmaren ad xasen aẓẓřen.

Naftali war izemmar ad yaẓẓeř x imezdaɣ n Bayt-Cams d imezdaɣ n Bayt-Ɛanat. Ammu i tuɣa izdeɣ di řwesṭ n ayt n Kenɛan, inni d imezdaɣ n temmurt. Tᵉttwagg xasen ljizya x imezdaɣ n Bayt-Cams d Bayt-Ɛanat.
Imuriyyen ḥṣaren ayt n Dan ɣar idurar, minzi war ten jjin ad hwan ɣar řewḍa n teɣzurt.
Tuɣa Imuriyyen ɛewwřen ad qqimen zeddɣen deg idurar n Ḥaras, di Ayalun u di Caɛalbim, maca afus n taddart n Yusuf tuɣa izeyyar xasen aṭṭas ařami xasen tᵉttwagg ljizya.
Tuɣa aymir n Imuriyyen zi Tsunta n Tɣarḍmiwin, zi jjarf uca ssenni ɣar sennej.

footnotes.text: Bazaq- isem wanita ixs ad yini ‘assam’.
Ɛutniyil- isem wanita ixs ad yini ‘ayrad n Arebbi’.
Tandint n Tcejjura n Tini- aqa-tt d tandint n Ariḥa.
Iciriyyen- ixs ad yini ‘ayt n Acir’.
